our_title: bal strategy variable stale after Sq and Zero, uninitialised for coarse graphs, divergent across folded halves
ran:
cd $WORK/repro/common (driver prints bal=<bbalglbval> balcalc=<|dlt|/avg>); base-combined UBSan tree:
  mpirun -np 3 ./bin_basefi/bipartfi 4elt.grf 0 'q{strat=f}' 0 1 -> 'rank 0: ... bal=1 balcalc=0.0061514802'
  ... 'q{strat=f}x{bal=0.001}z' -> 'bal=0.000897090862 balcalc=1'
  mpirun -np 2 ... 'm{asc=/(levl<0)?z;,low=q{strat=f}x{bal=0},seq=q{strat=f}x{bal=0},fold=d,dvert=100000,vert=100}' -> 'rank 0: ... bal=0.000128155837 balcalc=0.000128155837' / 'rank 1: ... bal=0 balcalc=0.000128155837' (np=4: rank 1 has 0.000128, ranks 0,2,3 have 0)
  with the default dvert/vert the coarse value is never initialised: 'bal=-5.31401037e+303' (pattern-initialised stack)
  mpirun -np 2 ... 'q{strat=f}q{strat=/(bal<0)?z;}' -> z runs ('load0=15606'): uninitialised bbalval of the gathered Bgraph
Patched (build, buildfi, builddbg): bal == balcalc on all ranks in every probe; (bal<0)?z no longer runs z (repro/DMO-09/*.txt).
severity_note: higher than the review's Low: the divergence across processes was reproduced (fold-dup is the default folding mode), and any user strategy with a 'bal' condition (as the shipped SCOTCH_stratDgraphMapBuild strings use 'bal=' parameters, a conditional on bal is a documented construct) can run different collectives on different processes and hang; also an uninitialised-memory read in bdgraphBipartSq's sequential strategy.
location_7_0_17: src/libscotch/bdgraph_bipart_ml.c:753 (copy from own coarse graph), bdgraph_bipart_ml.c:85-170 (bdgraphBipartMlCoarsen never sets bbalglbval), bdgraph_bipart_sq.c:235-240, bdgraph.c:178-193 (bdgraphZero), bdgraph_gather_all.c:248-254
evidence: bdgraph_bipart_ml.c:753 'finegrafptr->bbalglbval      = coargrafptr->bbalglbval;' after :748 'finegrafptr->compglbload0dlt = finegrafptr->compglbload0 - finegrafptr->compglbload0avg;' (the selected partition's loads); bdgraph_bipart_sq.c:235-240 set compglbload0..fronglbnbr but not bbalglbval; bdgraph.c:184-192 bdgraphZero sets loads but not bbalglbval; bdgraph_gather_all.c:248-254 set compload0dlt but not bbalval (only bgraphZero at :198 does, on the first call).
review_accuracy: Accurate; understated: besides staleness, the coarse graph's field is never initialised at all (garbage, not just stale), and the divergence across ranks is real (reproduced with duplicated folding).
first_pass_critique: Status/method right. It did not demonstrate the divergence because its probes used the default ml parameters (dvert=1000 means no folding on 4elt at np<=4, and the chain ends through the 'low' strategy whose q leaves the field untouched); its claim 'all ranks held the same stale value' was an artefact of that. Its preferred option A is the right shape but its sketch guards with 'compglbload0avg != 0' in some places and not others and uses ABS in bdgraph_bipart_ml.c while the file family uses the explicit ternary; its gather_all line uses the signed ratio (bgraph.c idiom) where every method uses the absolute one. Option B (recompute in bdgraphBipartSt) would leave the uninitialised coarse value and the gathered Bgraph's bbalval unfixed (the sequential strategy evaluates bal in bgraphBipartSt, not bdgraphBipartSt).

fix_options.label: A: recompute from the global loads wherever the partition changes (per-method idiom)
fix_options.summary: bdgraphZero, bdgraphBipartSq (after the Bcast), bdgraphBipartMlUncoarsen (instead of the copy) set bbalglbval = |compglbload0dlt|/compglbload0avg as df/ex/bd/store do; bdgraphGatherAll sets cgrfptr->bbalval the same way. Every graph then gets a valid value before any strategy runs on it (Zero at the coarsest level, Uncoarsen above).
fix_options.tested: probes above on the ASan, UBSan/pattern and DEBUG_ALL trees, np 2..4; builds with 0 warnings on the 32-bit ASan, 64-bit, UBSan/pattern-init and -DSCOTCH_DEBUG_ALL trees; full CHECKPTSCOTCH set on 32-bit and 64-bit trees and the dgraph subset on the DEBUG_ALL tree (SUMMARY.md); dgpart/dgord at -np 1..4 on 32/64-bit trees
fix_options.tradeoffs: Four producer sites to keep in sync for future methods (same as today for the other fields).
fix_options.maintainer_fit: It is his own convention: bdgraph_bipart_df.c:389, _ex.c:493, _bd.c:444, bdgraph_store.c:174 all end with exactly this assignment.

fix_options.label: B: refresh lazily in bdgraphBipartSt before evaluating a condition
fix_options.summary: One assignment in the STRATNODECOND case of bdgraphBipartSt.
fix_options.tested: applies on base-combined and compiles (-O2 -Wall, 0 diagnostics); not run
fix_options.tradeoffs: Single site, but hides that methods leave the field stale, and does nothing for the gathered Bgraph's bbalval (evaluated by bgraphBipartSt) nor for the uninitialised coarse value; departs from the per-method convention.
fix_options.maintainer_fit: No precedent in the tree for strategy variables being refreshed in the strategy evaluator.

cleanup_done: none needed (the coarse-to-fine copy line is replaced, no field or variable becomes unused)
test_added: ; no natural home: src/check has no test of strategy conditions on distributed active graphs and 'bal' is not observable through the public API; the driver repro/common/bipartfi.c is the test
notes: The band graph copy at bdgraph_bipart_bd.c:202 is left: the band graph's average is tilted by the anchor loads, so a recomputed ratio would differ slightly from the original graph's; the copy is of a now-correct value and the band strategy conditions see the original graph's ratio, which is the meaningful one. bdgraphInit2 keeps its signed, zero-guarded form (dlt >= 0 there).

ran:

  nth=6 (bgraphBipartGg OOM on rank 1): 'HANG; (1): ERROR: bdgraphBipartSq: cannot bipartition centralized graph; (1): ERROR: bdgraphBipartSq: internal error; rank 1: ret=1' (ranks 0,2 in MPI_Bcast); same at nth=23,24 (bgraphBipartFm)
  nth=25 (part array): '(1): ERROR: bdgraphBipartSq: out of memory (1); signal 11 (Segmentation fault)' (exit 139)
  nth=26 (frontier array): 'bdgraph_bipart_sq.c:282:42: runtime error: store to null pointer of type Gnum; signal 11'
Patched (buildfi): nth=6,23,24 -> all ranks 'ret=0' with the same partition and 'check=0'; nth=25,26 -> all ranks 'ret=1', no signal (repro/DMO-03/*.txt).
severity_note: higher than the review's Medium: reachable from the default SCOTCH_dgraphMap/Part strategy (q{strat=...} at the coarsest levels and in the sequential fallback), and the outcome is a hang of the whole job or a SIGSEGV on any single-process allocation failure
location_7_0_17: src/libscotch/bdgraph_bipart_sq.c:185-221 (:191-195 basing on NULL, :207-210 local count, :218 missing [5] test)
evidence: bdgraph_bipart_sq.c:207 'if ((reduloctab[4] != 0) && (reduloctab[4] != dgrfptr->s.procglbnbr)) { errorPrint ("bdgraphBipartSq: internal error"); return (1); }' (reduloctab is the local array); reduglbtab[5] (OR of allocation failures, :188, :193, :199) is never read; :195 'dgrfptr->partgsttax -= dgrfptr->s.baseval;' is executed when memAlloc returned NULL.
review_accuracy: Accurate; its 'Fix:' (test reduglbtab[4], check reduglbtab[5] before the broadcast, free what was built) is right but incomplete: the NULL part array is based (a non-NULL garbage pointer when baseval != 0), and 'internal error' on partial failure contradicts the reduction operator, which already selects the best partition among the processes whose sequential bipartitioning succeeded (sq.c:98-109).

It did not see the bdgraphGatherAll non-collective failures that its own harness hits two allocations earlier (nth=3..5 here: MPI abort).

evidence: base-combined common.h:321 '#define flagSet(a,n) (a)[(n) / (sizeof (unsigned int) << 3)] |= (1U << ((n) & ((sizeof (unsigned int) << 3) - 1)))'; bdgraph_bipart_bd.c:112 'unsigned int * restrict orgflagloctab;', :237 'memAlloc (flagSize (orggrafptr->s.vertlocnnd) * sizeof (unsigned int))'; bdgraph_bipart_ex.c:102-103 'unsigned int * restrict movegsttab; ... flagloctab;'
upstream_change: combined series 0074 (G13) 'Bugfix: apply left shifts to unsigned integers in remaining bit sets [report R. Perry]' (common.h macros, bdgraph_bipart_bd.c and bdgraph_bipart_ex.c arrays changed to unsigned int); covers every flagSet/flagVal use in bdgraph_bipart_bd.c (:343, :380, :382, :385, :388, :409) and bdgraph_bipart_ex.c (:371, :382, :385, :410-411, :435, :446, :455, :457)
review_accuracy: (not in the review) the first pass's location and diagnosis are accurate
first_pass_critique: Its 'use 1U << n' is what G13 did, through the shared macros rather than per site; nothing wrong.
notes: Status is 'fixed in the combined series', i.e. by G13's patch 0074, not by upstream 7.0.17; no duplicate commit.
